notes.title: Update 17 August
notes.content:
First of all, we're glad to announce that our new game I am weapon: reivval now fully released. Please, take a look if you haven't seen it yet: http://store.steampowered.com/app/335700

And starting from today we’re switching to Steam servers. It means that every time you’re playing in co-op mode, you’ll be using Steam server network instead of just a bunch of the servers we had.
This will ensure greater stability and smooth performance.

We’ve also made it possible for you to create gaming sessions available to all the other players and not just your friends.

[h1]Other improvements:[/h1][list]
[*]DirectX 11 compatibility
[*]Game objects causing lags when loading now optimized
[*]Dead zones settings for gamepad available[/list]

[h1]Bugs fixed:[/h1][list]
[*]Issue with the credits menu after game completion - fixed
[*]Crystal counter for DESPERADO achievement now seen on the Achievements page
[*]DLC score now also counted towards HARDCORE and HIGH FLYER achievements
[*] MASTER OF DEFENSE counter now stable
[*]N'Aliens DLC: “Hack the lock” mission bug after entering the Red Room now fixed[/list]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6105927/a6fc2ecdbc0ad999a8125fa3af67acc5a47f8152.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Update April 11
notes.content:
We’re a bit late with the update but it’s literally the most important update since the game release.
[list]
[*]We rewrote co-op code from scratch, so now you don’t need to set up router and do any other stuff to play coop.
[*]Steam Cloud support.
[*]The Italian language.
[/list]
Bugs:
[list]
[*]Unavailability to build turrets in some cases.
[*]Unavailability to upgrade Sphere turret.
[*]Health bar spinning.
[/list]
Coop Bugs:
[list]
[*]Enemies spawning in screenview during cooperative mode.
[*]Infinite enemies spawning when both players are dead.
[*]Constant presence of 2nd player's spot on the radar.
[*]No damage to enemies from 2nd player.
[*]Graphics glitches of Electric Storm ability.
[*]Ability reloading bar shows up immediately, not after second click on it.
[*]2nd player now can see credits menu and go to the Map when game is completed.
[*]2nd player's state indicator now shows up correctly and indicates proper path.
[/list]
Gamepad:
[list]
[*]Inoperability of some gamepads.
[*]Minor bugs.
[/list]

Now we’re migrating to Unity 5 so prepare for the performance
and appearance  improvements!

notes.title: Bugs massacre!
notes.content:
Hello guys, here is our new update. It’s been very hard days to us.
Thanks to all who sent us reports via Support and Community. We try to do our best and solve almost all the problems.

New:
- Full controller support status: now Steam keyboard available to enter text in Big Picture mode.
- Mac version and Coop stability improvements.
- Energy value now is on battlefield screen.

New hotkeys:
- Tower mode.
- Switch weapons (“[“ and “]”).
- Stand tower.
- Repair and Sell tower.

Bugs:
- HDR doesn’t save. Now it’s default hidden setting.
- Tower upgrade brunches cured. Now you can’t buy tower which you can’t place on battlefield.
- Now you can’t rebuy the same tower.
- Spray gas turret now available and doesn’t vanish.
- Smart Trap 17 works and slows enemies.
- Mater on the last level isn’t appeared out of reach.
- Level achievement of Data Units of Server level now shows proper data.
- Achievements ASSAULTER and ONEMAN ARMY now works.
- Achievements SURVIVED, STRATEGIST and COMMANDOS now works properly. If you don’t get it after game complete just complete any level again.
- Now there’s no Support button in the battlescreen.
- Coop: now there's no problem to puck up resources.

In the next updates:
- Invite friend to play coop in game UI.
- Steam cloud support.
- Custom controls.

notes.title: Cooperative mode test version is here!
notes.content:
Hi, friends! We are ready to publish a first update with coop game mode. This is a test update only for PC version. Please place your replies, suggestions and just comments on forum. Further updates of coop mode will be soon.
Also, be ready to be surprised on Halloween!

P.S.: To create a server do next steps:
1. In the Main Menu push the Cooperative button
2. Next, push the Create button
3. After the map has been loaded, don't choose level (yes it's not a user-friendly thing), just wait while your friend is connecting to your server (you should apply a connection request from your friend); only your friends in Steam can see your server

To connect to your friend's server:
1. In the Main Menu push the Cooperative button
2. Next, push the Connect button
3. After a server list has been loaded click a server you need
4. Wait while a server answering your connection request
5. Wait while a server choosing a level
6. When you see in the center of screen a window with a level name and an apply button, press that button

tags.feature: This is a test update only for PC version.

notes.title: Hello guys, our second update has finally arrived!
notes.content:
[h1]What’s new?[/h1]
 • Window mode available.
 • Improved English localization.
 • Trading cards.
 • Now the character stops immediately, with no delay after you depress the direction buttons.
 • Speed of all bullets and projectiles doubled.
 • Store: more info on upgrades - now you can see an additional bar under each item with upgrade values.

[h1]Bug fixes.[/h1]
 • Achievements: now you get achievements immediately (not after closing the game). Watch for the pop-up Steam messages when playing.
 • Shooting: infinite reload loop fixed.
 • Turrets: now all turrets stop shooting when broken.
 • Store: scroll buttons fixed, now enabled for all controllers.

[h1]We’re slightly behind with Steam Cloud support but you’ll see it in the next update.
Our work on the co-op mode is in full swing and we’re closer and closer to full release. Stay tuned![/h1]
